Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players stride out to the middle. Pathum Nissanka and Kusal Mendis will open the batting for Sri Lanka. Tendai Chatara will begin the proceedings with the ball. Here we go...
...THE RUN CHASE...

Sri Lanka, on the other hand, did leak runs in the beginning, but have done well not to let Zimbabwe get away with a bigger total. The spinners have been exceptional, Jeffrey Vandersay was the leader of the pack. He managed to grab 3 wickets and all of them came when Sri Lanka needed them the most. Although Maheesh Theekshana took just one wicket, he did well not to leak a lot of runs and troubled the batters a lot. The pacers were expensive and gave a lot of runs, they were not at their best in the middle today. But, it's now onto the batters. They chased down a target close to 300 in the previous game, and coming into bat again they would feel confident to chase this down as well. They have a strong batting unit and also the surface remains to be batting friendly. Will Sri Lanka repeat their classy batting performance? Or will Zimbabwe come out on top this time? We will find out.

Zimbabwe got off to a flying start, but after losing the openers, the run rate did decrease a tad. Their skipper, Craig Ervine was exceptional in the middle. He was unfortunate to miss out on his 100 by just 9 runs. Craig Ervine along with Sean Williams put on a 106-run partnership and put Sri Lanka under pressure in the middle overs. Sikandar Raza played a fine innings of 56 and guided Zimbabwe to a total of 302. They have put up a healthy total on the board and will be hoping the bowlers defend the total this time and keep the series alive.

Another fine batting performance by Zimbabwe! They would still feel they are still about 15 runs short here. Sri Lanka have done well to restrict Zimbabwe at the death. This is exactly what happened in the first match as well. But this time Zimbabwe have done well to get over the 300-run mark.

OUT! TAKEN! Nuwan Pradeep takes the wicket of Raza on the last ball of the innings but he has played a brilliant knock for his side here. This was a slower ball, into the wicket, outside off. Raza looks to go over mid off but he fails to get the elevation and hits it straight towards Chamika Karunaratne at mid off who hops and takes a good catch. Zimbabwe finish with 302/8.
Commentary.Howout: c Chamika Karunaratne b Nuwan Pradeep

Commentary.Commentary: A slower ball, into the wicket, outside off. Sikandar Raza cuts it over the point fielder and collects a couple of runs.

Bye! WOW! A top yorker, around leg. Blessing Muzarabani fails to dig it out and Kusal Mendis behind the sticks does well to stop it by diving to his left. The batters steal a bye. 300 up for Zimbabwe!
A short ball, around leg. Sikandar Raza pulls it towards deep square leg for a run.
Blessing Muzarabani comes to the crease now.

OUT! TAKEN! Fuller in length, around middle. Wellington Masakadza looks to scoop it over the short fine leg fielder but he mistimes it and hits it straight to Dushmantha Chameera at short fine leg who takes an easy catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Dushmantha Chameera b Nuwan Pradeep

Commentary.Commentary: A slower ball, shorter in length, around leg. Sikandar Raza pulls it towards deep square leg for a run.

OUT! RUN OUT! Top effort from Dushmantha Chameera to get rid of Ryan Burl. A yorker, around middle. Sikandar Raza digs it out and looks to steal a run. The ball bounces off the deck and Chameera is quick enough to get towards the ball. He picks it up and scores a direct hit at the striker's end. Burl is short of his crease and he walks back to the hut now.

Is that a run-out? A direct hit at the keeper's end from the bowler. The replay rolls in and confirms the batsman was short of his ground. The third umpire confirms that was out. Ryan Burl has to walk back.
A slower ball, into the pitch, around off. Ryan Burl tonks it towards deep mid-wicket and takes a run.
On a length, around off. Ryan Burl heaves it towards the deep mid-wicket region for a couple of runs.
FOUR! EDGY! Banged into the deck, outside off. Ryan Burl pulls but it goes off the top edge and flies over the keeper for a boundary.
Full ball, around off. Sikandar Raza drills it back past the bowler and takes a run.
FOUR! Lovely shot! What a way bring up your fifty! A slower ball, into the wicket, outside off. Sikandar Raza hangs back and chips it over the mid off fielder to fetch himself a boundary.
Wide! A slower ball, well outside off. Sikandar Raza lets it be and the umpire calls it as a wide.
Dushmantha Chameera will continue, he is in his 9th over.
A slower ball, on a length, around middle. Sikandar Raza hoicks it to the deep mid-wicket region for a single.
On a length, around middle. Ryan Burl heaves it towards deep mid-wicket and manages only a run.
Back of a length, outside off. Sikandar Raza pushes it towards the cover fielder and collects a run.
Banged into the deck, around off. Burl stays back and pulls it along the ground towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Fuller in length, around middle. Sikandar Raza drags it towards long on for a single.
FOUR! Nicely done! A slower ball, into the wicket, outside off. Sikandar Raza moves across in his crease and scoops it over the short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
A slower ball, on a length, around off. Sikandar Raza drags it towards long on and settles for a single.
A yorker, around middle. Sikandar Raza digs it out watchfully.
Banged into the deck, outside off. Burl miscues his pull in the air towards the mid-wicket region. It falls well short of the deep fielder and the batters take a run.
Full ball, outside off. Sikandar Raza looks to slog but it goes off the outer half of the blade towards the third man region for a run.
A low full toss, around middle. Ryan Burl tucks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
A short ball, around middle. Ryan Burl looks to pull but does not get any bat on it.
Full and wide, outside off. Ryan Burl squeezes it out to the off side and takes a single.
FOUR! Easy pickings! A low full toss, outside off. Ryan Burl reaches out, frees his arms and carves it through the cover region for a boundary.
Short of a length, outside off. Sikandar Raza cuts it wide of the third man fielder for a single.
A slower ball, on a length, outside off. Sikandar Raza looks to cut but the ball sneaks through his bat.
Back of a length, outside off. Sikandar Raza stays back and cuts it past the point fielder to collect a couple of runs.
Fuller in length, outside off. Ryan Burl digs it out to the off side for a run.
Shorter ball, outside off. Ryan Burl hops and taps it towards third man scampers through to the other end. He retains the strike.
Back of a length, outside off. Raza pushes it towards cover and takes a single.
Touch fuller, outside off. Sikandar Raza drives it past the diving fielder at cover for a brace.
Shorter ball, outside off. Ryan Burl taps it towards cover and scampers through to the other end.
Beaten! A length ball, outside off. Ryan Burl looks to drive this but gets beaten.
Back of a length, outside off. Sikandar Raza dabs it to third man. A single taken.
Loopy ball, down the leg side. Ryan Burl clips it to the fielder at short fine leg. Maheesh Theekshana ends his spell with 1 for 49 runs.
Ryan Burl is the new man in.

OUT! TIMBER! Craig Ervine is dismissed for 91! He will miss out on his 100. A flatter ball, on the off pole, full in length. Craig Ervine prods to drive this but misses. The ball beats the outside edge and knocks the off pole. Maheesh Theekshana strikes in his last over. Much needed wicket here for the hosts.
Full and on middle. Sikandar Raza whips it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy ball, around middle. Craig Ervine drags it towards long on for a single.
Fuller this time, around the leg. Craig Ervine works it away with soft hands towards deep square leg for a brace. Craig Ervine is into the 90s!
Flatter and quicker, around middle. Raza stays back and pushes it towards deep cover for a single.
Fuller in length, around middle. Sikandar Raza clips it to deep mid-wicket and collects a single.
Tossed up, on a length, outside off and spinning away late. Sikandar Raza looks to block but the ball spins past his blade.
FOUR! CRUNCHED! Tossed up, outside off. Sikandar Raza prods and caresses it through the cover region for a boundary.
Leg bye! Flatter ball, around middle. Craig Ervine misses his nudge on the leg side and gets hit on the pads. The ball rolls to the leg side for a leg bye.
FOUR! Nicely done! Tossed up, around leg. Craig Ervine gets down on his knee and sweeps it behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Tossed up, around middle. Craig Ervine defends it out.
Back of a length, around off. Craig Ervine pushes it towards long off. A single taken.
Touch shorter, outside off. Craig Ervine drives it to the fielder at extra cover.
Tossing it up, outside off. Sikandar Raza drives it towards long off for a single.
Full in length, around leg. Craig Ervine works it away towards mid-wicket for a single.
Another full ball, on middle. Craig Ervine pushes it back to the bowler.
Full in length, on middle. Craig Ervine gets a leading edge towards cover. No run there.
Loopy ball, full. Craig Ervine lofts it towards long on for a single. He retains the strike.
Full again, outside off. Sikandar Raza pushes it towards extra cover for another single.
Full, at the leg stump. Worked away towards long on. A single taken.
Jeffrey Vandersay serves a loopy ball, outside off. Sikandar Raza guides to third man for a single.
Outside off, another fuller ball. Craig Ervine dabs it towards third man for single.
Jeffrey Vandersay (7-0-36-3) is back on.
A leg break, outside off, on a full length. Sikandar Raza pushes it towards extra cover for a single.
This is a bit fuller in length, around middle. Sikandar Raza drills it down the ground and collects a single.
On a length, outside off. Craig Ervine drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Craig Ervine blocks it out.
BEATEN! Good-length ball, just outside off and shaping away a bit. Craig Ervine looks to drive on the up but he fails to get any bat on it as the ball zips past his outside edge.
Short of a length, around middle. Craig Ervine pulls it along the ground towards deep square leg for a couple of runs.
Good-length ball, around off. Sikandar Raza taps it towards backward point for a single.
Nicely tossed up, around middle. Craig Ervine keeps it out. Just 3 runs off the over!
Flatter and quicker, around off. Craig Ervine blocks it out.
Floated, on a length, around middle. Sikandar Raza eases it to long on for a single.
Tossed up, on a length, outside off. Sikandar Raza pushes it to cover.
Flatter ball, drifting onto the pads. Craig Ervine tucks it towards square leg and collects a run.
Flatter ball, around middle. Sikandar Raza nudges it to the leg side for a single.
Maheesh Theekshana (7-038-0) is back on!
Short of a length, around leg. Craig Ervine misses his heave on the leg side and the ball brushes his pad before going to the keeper.
Back of a length, around off. Craig Ervine punches it to the cover fielder.
Full ball, outside off. Sikandar Raza drives it towards deep cover for a run.
On a length, outside off. Sikandar Raza pushes it towards the cover fielder.
A short ball, outside off. Sikandar Raza looks to ramp it over the keeper but he fails to get any bat on it.
FOUR! Top shot! Length ball, around off. Sikandar Raza drills it back past the bowler and bags a boundary.
Jeffrey Vandersay drops it short this time. Sikandar Raza pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single. He retains the strike.
Full and outside off. Sikandar Raza prods and drives it towards deep cover for a brace.
SIX! BOOM! Jeffrey Vandersay misses his length and serves a low full toss ball. Sikandar Raza tonks this over long on for a biggie.
This one stayed low! A googly, around middle. Sikandar Raza does well to block it out.
TWO BYES! Sharp turn! Tosses this one up wide of off. Sikandar Raza misses his drive and the ball deflects off the keeper's gloves goes past the first slip fielder towards third man. Two byes taken.
Loopy ball, a googly. Sikandar Raza stays in his crease and blocks it out.
Back of a length, outside off. Sikandar Raza cuts it towards cover and takes a single.
Full ball, around leg. Craig Ervine flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Short of a length, around leg. Sikandar Raza glances it towards fine leg for a run.
Sikandar Raza comes to the crease now.

OUT! BOWLED! You miss, I hit, says Chamika Karunaratne. This was a length ball, around off. Wesley Madhevere looks for a heave on the leg side but he misses and the ball crashes onto his off pole. This was a nothing shot from Wesley Madhevere and he would be very gutted with himself.
Back of a length, outside off. Wesley Madhevere punches it to extra cover.
Full ball, outside off. Wesley Madhevere drives it to the cover fielder.
Short and on middle. Wesley Madhevere pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.

Stumping-check! Sri Lanka appeal for a stumping and the umpire decides to send it upstairs. Wesley Madhevere had his foot outside the crease but he has has dragged it back just in time as indicated by the replays.

NOT OUT! Another peach of a delivery by Jeffrey Vandersay. A loopy ball, and a leg break this time. Wesley Madhevere leans and looks to drive this but gets beaten as the ball turns away from him. Kusal Mendis grabs the ball and whips the bails off. The umpire sends it upstairs and the replay shows Wesley Madhevere was well in.
Outside off, a loopy delivery. Wesley Madhevere prods and defends it out.
Firing it on the leg stump, on a length. Craig Ervine flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller ball, outside off. Craig Ervine blocks it out watchfully.

FOUR! Poor delivery from Jeffrey Vandersay and Craig Ervine is not going to miss out on these! Shorter ball, wide of off. Craig Ervine, on the back foot, punches it to deep cover for a boundary. That brings up the 200 for Zimbabwe!
Fuller, outside off. Wesley Madhevere drives it to the man at mid off.
Back of a length, outside off. Craig Ervine stands tall and taps it towards mid off for a single.
Back of a length, down the leg side. Craig Ervine misses his pull and gets beaten.
Swing and a miss! On a length, wide of off. Craig Ervine swings hard at it but fails to get any bat on it.
A length ball, darting it on the pads, at 132 clicks. Craig Ervine tucks it towards deep mid-wicket for a brace.
A full ball, around middle. Craig Ervine pushes it back to the bowler.

DRINKS! Well, one would wonder why Jeffrey Vandersay was brought back into the attack so late after his impressive first spell. However, the Sri Lankans have now got the much-needed breakthrough and they will be eager to chip in with few more wickets and put the brakes on the scoring. Zimbabwe were going along really nicely until the wicket of Sean Williams and it is now upto their skipper, Craig Ervine to take his team to a big total. Wesley Madhevere walks out to bat now. Also, Chamika Karunaratne (3-0-13-0) is back on.

OUT! STUMPED! Jeffrey Vandersay comes back and strikes once again! He should have probably come on earlier! A loopy ball, spinning away from outside off. Sean Williams leans and looks to flick but misses as the ball turns away from him. Kusal Mendis grabs the ball and whips the bails off quickly. The umpire sends it upstairs but Sean Williams is walking back as he knows he is well out of his crease. Huge blow this for the tourists!
Commentary.Howout: st Kusal Mendis b Jeffrey Vandersay

Commentary.Commentary: Outside off, touch shorter. Craig Ervine pushes it towards long on for a single.
FOUR! Top shot! Short and wide of off. Craig Ervine, on back foot, chops that away towards deep cover for boundary.
Flatter and quicker. Sean Williams works it towards mid-wicket for another single.
Another short ball, around the pads. Craig Ervine flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single. That brings up the 100-run stand between these two.
Shorter ball, around middle. Craig Ervine taps it towards deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Fuller, around middle. Craig Ervine taps it to mid-wicket for a single
Short ball, down the leg side. Craig Ervine misses his pull shot.
On a length, around leg. Sean Williams works it away towards mid-wicket for a single.
Top effort! A short ball, down the leg side. Craig Ervine pulls it, at Dinesh Chandimal at short fine leg dives to his left and makes an unbelievable stop.
NO BALL! A length ball, outside off. Sean Williams taps it to third man for a single. No ball called for overstepping. Free hit to follow.
Back of a length, outside off. Craig Ervine pushes it to deep cover. A single taken.
Leg bye! On a length, on the pads. Sean Williams misses his flick and gets hit on his pad. The ball rolls to the leg side for a leg bye.
Another flatter ball, short as well. Sean Williams works it away towards long on for a single.
Flatter ball, around middle. Craig Ervine pushes it to long off for a single.
FOUR! Up and over! A full ball, outside off. Craig Ervine drives it over cover for a boundary. Top shot!
Fuller, around off. Sean Williams pushes it to long off for a single.
Outside off, touch shorter. Sean Williams slashes it towards deep cover for a brace.

Shorter ball, around the pads. Craig Ervine clips it towards fine leg for a single. FIFTY for Craig Ervine! That's been a fine innings from the skipper so far and he would be aware that the job is still half done.
Another run out chance! There is a direct hit at the striker's end. But Sean Williams once again has made his ground well. Not out says the third umpire.

NOT OUT! Sean Williams is well home! Good-length ball, around off. Craig Ervine looks to flick but he gets an inside edge onto his pad. The ball rolls to the off side and the batters take a single. The fielder at point scores a direct hit at the striker's end but Williams is home.
Back of a length, around off. Craig Ervine keeps it out.
BEATEN! Good-length ball, just outside off and angling across the batter. Craig Ervine looks for a booming drive but the ball goes past his blade.
FOUR! Lovely timing from Ervine! Short of a length, angling in from middle. Craig Ervine hangs back and whips it in front of square and collects a boundary.
Good-length ball, around off. Sean Williams stays back, works it towards mid on and scampers through to the other end.
Back of a length, outside off. Sean Williams looks to cut but it goes off the inner half of the blade towards backward point.
Flatter and quicker, on a length, outside off. Craig Ervine cuts but finds the extra cover fielder.
Nicely tossed up, around off. Craig Ervine defends it off the front foot.
Flatter ball, around off. Sean Williams taps it towards point and takes off for a quick single.

Is that a run-out? A throw at the keeper's end. The keeper has whipped the bails off and Williams could be in trouble. The replay rolls in and confirms that Sean Williams is inside his crease. Not out displayed on the big screen.

Good running! Looped up, on a length, around middle. Sean Williams clips it to mid-wicket and comes back for the second run. The fielder in the deep throws it to the keeper who whips the bails off but Williams had made it to the crease.
Flatter ball, going on with the angle from middle. Craig Ervine keeps it out.
Tossed up, outside off. Sean Williams looks to push it through the off side but it goes off the inside half of the blade towards mid-wicket for a run.
Charith Asalanka comes into the attack.
Good-length delivery, around off. Craig Ervine taps it towards backward point.
Slightly shorter in length, outside off. Sean Williams opens the face of his bat and steers it to third man. A single taken!
On a length, outside off. Craig Ervine guides it towards third man for a run.

FOUR! EDGY! Good-length ball, around off and angling across the batter. Craig Ervine looks to punch it through the cover region but he gets a thick outside edge which flies to the left of the keeper and into the fence.
Back of a length, around middle. Sean Williams just tucks it towards deep mid-wicket. Williams wanted the second run but it sent back by his skipper.
On a length, jagging back in from middle. Craig Ervine flicks it behind square on the leg side and takes a single.
Nuwan Pradeep (3-0-27-0) is brought back into the attack.
On a length, around middle. Craig Ervine eases it to long on for a run.
Tossed up, outside off. Sean Williams prods and pushes it through the cover region for a single.
Flatter ball, coming in with the angle from middle. Sean Williams misses his flick and gets hit on his pad.
Flatter ball, fuller in length, down leg. Craig Ervine glances it behind square on the leg side for one.

Review! Sri Lanka have reviewed an LBW decision against Craig Ervine. The replay rolls in. UltraEdge confirms that there is a flat line as the ball passes through the bat. Ball Tracker shows that the ball would have clipped the leg stump, but it is umpire's call on wickets. The on-field decision stays. Craig Ervine survives.

NOT OUT! Craig Ervine SURVIVES! Theekshana tosses it up, around middle and spinning in late. Craig Ervine prods and looks to reverse sweep but he misses and gets hit on his pad. Sri Lanka appeal but the umpire says no. Dasun Shanaka opts for a review. Nothing on the UltraEdge. The Ball Tracker suggests that the ball would have just clipped the leg stump and it is umpire's call on wickets.
Flatter ball, around off. Craig Ervine blocks it off the front foot.
Slightly shorter in length, outside off. Craig Ervine stands tall and drives it on the up towards deep cover for a run.
A bit fuller this time, outside off. Sean Williams pushes it wide of the mid off fielder and takes a single.
Length ball, well outside off. Sean Williams presses forward, frees his arms and caresses it through the cover region. Pathum Nissanka does well in the deep to keep it to just two.
On a length, angling in from off. Sean Williams blocks it as he gets cramped for room.
Back of a length, outside off. Craig Ervine hangs back to cut but it goes off the thick outside edge towards third man for a single.
Good-length ball, around off. Craig Ervine presses forward and drives it on the up towards the cover fielder.
Flatter and quicker, on the pads. Sean Williams flicks it towards deep square leg for a brace.
FOUR! Glorious! A very flighted delivery, in the slot. Sean Williams waits for it and drives it beautifully through cover for a boundary.
Swing and a miss! A fuller ball, outside off. Sean Williams hangs back and looks to cut it away but misses.
Fuller ball, firing it on the stumps. Sean Williams blocks it with a straight bat.
Flat again, angling it in on the stumps. Sean Williams, on back foot, blocks it on the off side.
Flatter ball, around off. Craig Ervine taps it to cover and takes a single.
Maheesh Theekshana (5-0-28-0) comes back to bowl.
Great stop! A length ball, outside off. Sean Williams taps it towards point. Kamindu Mendis there, runs and dives to his right and stops the ball. Saved two runs there.
BEATEN! A length ball, outside off. Sean Williams looks to have a poke at it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Quick single! A shorter ball, outside off. Craig Ervine hops and blocks it out onto the deck. The ball bounces over the stumps and the batters steal a quick single.
Touch fuller, outside off, at 143.5 clicks. Craig Ervine leans and pushes it towards point. He wants a single, but he is sent back by his partner. No run there.
Another length ball, around the pads this time. Sean Williams clips it towards mid-wicket and takes a quick single.
Good-length ball, around middle. Sean Williams shows the full face of his bat and blocks it out.
Dushmantha Chameera (4-0-17-0) is back on.
Kamindu Mendis serves a short ball, around middle. Sean Williams flicks it towards mid-wicket off the back foot. A single to end the over. Good over for Zimbabwe!
Short again, outside off. Craig Ervine pushes it to long off for a single.
FOUR! Poor delivery and punished again! Another shorter ball, down the leg side. Craig Ervine hangs back, swivels, and pulls it towards fine leg for a boundary.
Fuller and loopy ball, outside off. Sean Williams taps it towards cover for a quick single.
Tossing it up, around middle. Sean Williams prods and blocks it out solidly.
FOUR! CRUNCHED! A shorter ball, wide of off. Sean Williams hangs back and drills that past mid on for a boundary.
Quick single! A full ball, outside off. Sean Williams pushes it towards mid off and scampers through to the other end. 2 runs off that over.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Sean Williams opens the face of his bat and pushes it towards point.
BEATEN! Much better from Chamika Karunaratne! A length ball, shaping it away from outside off. Sean Williams looks to have a poke at it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Full again, outside off. Sean Williams drives it to the man at mid off.
Good-length delivery, on the pads. Craig Ervine tucks it towards square leg. A single taken.
Full ball, outsdie off. Craig Ervine pushes it towards the fielder at extra cover.
Another fuller ball, around off. Craig Ervine taps it to point for a quick single.
Loopy ball, fuller, around off. Craig Ervine leans and blocks it out towards point.
Much flatter and quicker. Sean Williams tucks it past mid on for a single.
FOUR! Perfect execution! A tossed up delivery, around middle. Sean Williams gets low and reverse-sweeps this towards deep point for a boundary.
Loopy ball, around middle. Sean Williams tucks it towards mid-wicket. No run there.
Kamindu Mendis starts with a flatter ball, around off. Sean Williams cuts that towards deep cover for a brace.
Kamindu Mendis comes into the attack.
Banged into the deck, around middle. Sean Williams stays back and pulls it towards deep square leg for a run.
Length ball, outside off. Craig Ervine drives hard but the fielder at mid off dives and keeps it to just one.
Good-length ball, around middle. Sean Williams prods and nudges it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
On a length, outside off. Craig Ervine turns it to the off side and collects an easy single.
FOUR! Excellent timing and placement! Back of a length, around leg. Craig Ervine hangs back and pulls it behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Good running! Length ball, around off. Sean Williams taps it towards point and scampers through to the other end.
Slower through the air and around middle. Craig Ervine keeps it out watchfully.
Looped up, around middle and spinning in late. Sean Williams looks to defend but it goes off the inner half of the blade towards square leg for a run.
On a length, outside off. Craig Ervine eases it towards long off for one.
Nicely tossed up, outside off. Sean Williams prods and pushes it through the cover region for a single.
Flatter ball, darted on the pads. Craig Ervine nudges it to the leg side and gives the strike back to Sean Williams.
Tossed up, around middle. Craig Ervine defends it out.
Good-length ball, just outside off. Craig Ervine prods and pushes it towards mid off for a run. 100 comes up for Zimbabwe!
Back of a length, outside off. Sean Williams hangs back and guides it wide of the third man fielder for a single.
Good-length ball, around off. Sean Williams taps it towards the backward point fielder.
Back of a length, on off. Sean Williams is cramped for room and he keeps it out.
A bit fuller this time, around middle. Sean Williams flicks it towards mid-wicket.
On a length, around off. Sean Williams defends it off the front foot.
Chamika Karunaratne will roll his arm over now.
On a length, outside off. Sean Williams eases it towards long off and keeps the strike for the next over.
Flatter and quicker, around off. Sean Williams blocks it out.
Tossed up, outside off. Craig Ervine presses forward and works it towards long off for a run.
BEATEN! Fuller in length, outside off and turning away late. Craig Ervine looks to defend but the ball spins past his outside edge.
Flatter ball, on a length, outside off. Sean Williams stays back and cuts it to sweeper cover for one.
Flatter ball, outside off. Sean Williams defends it out.
FOUR! Top shot! Loopy ball, on a length, outside off. Craig Ervine lunges forward and carves it past the mid off fielder to bag a boundary.
Tossed up, outside off. Sean Williams prods and pushes it through the cover region for a single to get off the mark.

DRINKS! A solid start from Zimbabwe once again. But, Sri Lanka have done well to pick up two wickets. Jeffrey Vandersay has been exceptional, he has sent back the Zimbabwe openers, and has now added some pressure on them. Also, Sean Williams comes to the crease now.

OUT! STUMPED! This is very clever from Jeffrey Vandersay and he gets his second wicket! Vandersay sees Chakabva skipping down so he bowls it fuller and wider, outside off. Regis Chakabva looks to go inside out by stepping out but he misses as the ball spins past his blade. Kusal Mendis, behind the sticks collects the ball cleanly and whips the bails off in a flash. Chakabva is well short of the crease and he walks back to the hut.
Commentary.Howout: st Kusal Mendis b Jeffrey Vandersay

Commentary.Commentary: Loopy ball, fuller in length, outside off. Regis Chakabva looks for a reverse sweep but he misses.
Flatter ball, into the wicket, around middle. Regis Chakabva stays back and tucks it towards mid-wicket.
An overpitched ball, around middle. Regis Chakabva digs it out.
Tosses this one up, on middle. Craig Ervine leans and blocks it out.
Maheesh Theekshana misses his length, serves a full toss. Regis Chakabva drags it towards long on for a single.
Fuller, loopy ball, around off. Craig Ervine pushes it towards cover for a single.
Flatter, fuller, around the elg side. Regis Chakabva tickles it away towards fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Regis Chakabva! And again! Another fuller ball, around middle. Regis Chakabva sweeps this crisply towards square leg for another boundary in the over.
FOUR! A loopy ball, around middle. Regis Chakabva shuffles across and sweeps this uppishly towards deep square leg fora boundary. Crisp shot!
Floated, on a length, around middle. Regis Chakabva nudges it to the leg side for a single.
Tossed up, around off. Regis Chakabva defends it out.
Flatter ball, around leg. Craig Ervine prods and flicks it towards the leg side for a single.
On a length, around middle. Craig Ervine blocks it out.
Tossed up, outside off. Regis Chakabva skips down the track and eases it to long off for a run.
Flatter ball, outside off. Regis Chakabva looks to cut but it goes off the underedge and onto the deck.
Touch shorter, around middle. Craig Ervine drives it towards sweeper cover for a single.

NOT OUT! A huge appeal for LBW! This one was spinning in on the pads, on a full length. Craig Ervine leans and looks to drive but misses and gets rapped on the front pad. A loud shout and the umpire raises his finger. Craig Ervine goes up for the review! The replay rolls in. No bat involved confirms UltraEdge. Ball Tracker shows that it is missing the wickets. The on-field decision has to be overturned. Craig Ervine survives!

Review time! Craig Ervine opts for a review as he has been adjudged LBW! No bat involved, confirms the UltraEdge! Wait, the Ball Tracker suggests that the angle of the ball would have taken it way down leg and Ervine survives!
Outside off, full in length. Regis Chakabva drags it towards long on for a single.
Quicker, around middle. Regis Chakabva hangs back and pushes it back to the bowler.
Loopy ball, on middle. Regis Chakabva blocks it out.
Fuller, around middle. Craig Ervine flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Touch shorter, outside off. Craig Ervine cuts it towards point for a single He retains the strike.

FOUR LEG BYES! A googly this time, around off. Craig Ervine advances down the pitch and gets beaten as the ball spins away from him. The ball deflects off his back pad and flies to the left of the keeper. Kusal Mendis fails to grab the ball, and the ball races away towards the boundary.
Touch fuller again, on middle. Regis Chakabva steps down the pitch and pushes it towards long on for a single.
Another fuller ball, around middle. Craig Ervine sweeps it towards deep square leg for a brace.
Loopy ball, fuller, on middle. Craig Ervine blocks it out.

A huge appeal for LBW, but not given! A loopy ball, around leg. Craig Ervine looks to sweep but misses. The ball hits the front pad and the Sri Lankan's appeal. But, that was probably missing the leg stump.
Fuller ball, around middle. Craig Ervine drags it towards long off for a single.
Spinning it in on the pads. Craig Ervine misses his flick and gets hit on the pads. A stifled appeal but the umpire is unmoved.
FOUR! Cleverly done! Fuller and around off. Craig Ervine shuffles across and paddles it towards fine leg for a boundary. He gets off the mark with that four.
Fuller, around middle. Craig Ervine blocks it out.
Another flatter ball, around the pads. Regis Chakabva works it towards square leg for a single.
Maheesh Theekshana starts with a flatter ball, around middle. Regis Chakabva tucks it towards square leg for a brace.

OUT! BOWLED! Jeffrey Vandersay strikes and Shanaka's ploy to bring on a leggie has worked for the hosts! This was a tossed up delivery, around off and going on with the angle. Takudzwanashe Kaitano prods and looks to play for the turn. He misses as the ball doesn't turn and it crashes onto his off stump. Zimbabwe lose their first wicket.
Craig Ervine comes out to bat at number 3.
A googly, around middle. Takudzwanashe Kaitano pulls it towards square leg.
A half-tracker, around middle. Takudzwanashe Kaitano rocks back and pulls hard but finds the fielder at square leg.
Tossed up, outside off. Regis Chakabva prods and eases it towards long off for a run.
Flatter ball, on off. Regis Chakabva blocks it.
Flatter ball, outside off. Regis Chakabva cuts it towards the cover fielder.
Jeffrey Vandersay comes into the attack.
SIX! Easy pickings! Back of a length, angling down leg. Takudzwanashe Kaitano stays back, rides the bounce nicely and whips it behind square on the leg side to bag a maximum.
Good-length ball, outside off. Takudzwanashe Kaitano defends it to the off side.
On a length, around middle. Regis Chakabva tucks it to the leg side and takes off for a run.
A short ball, outside off. Regis Chakabva leaves it alone.

Top effort from Pathum Nissanka in the deep! Full ball, outside off. Takudzwanashe Kaitano looks to drive but it goes off the outer half of the blade over the cover fielder. Nissanka gives it a chase, dives just in front of the ropes and saves a run for his side.
Back of a length, outside off. Regis Chakabva guides it towards third man and takes a single.
Length ball, outside off. Takudzwanashe Kaitano pushes it through the cover-point region. The fielder there fumbles and the batters collect a couple of runs.
Top shot for no runs! A bit fuller this time, around middle. Kaitano drives it hard but straight to the mid on fielder.
FOUR! Takudzwanashe Kaitano breaks the shackles! Banged into the deck, outside off. Takudzwanashe Kaitano hangs back and flat-bats it over the mid off fielder to fetch himself a boundary.
On a length, around off. Takudzwanashe Kaitano defends it out. Chameera is hitting good lines and lengths here!
A pacy delivery, back of a length, just outside off. Takudzwanashe Kaitano looks to defend but it takes the toe end and the ball falls just wide of the sticks.
Good-length ball, on middle. Takudzwanashe Kaitano blocks it out towards mid on.
Back of a length, outside off. Regis Chakabva stays back and looks to cut but he misses. A tidy over from Sri Lanka's skipper!
Short of a length, around off. Regis Chakabva looks to run it down to third man but it goes off the bottom half of the bat and onto the deck.
Length ball, outside off. Regis Chakabva drives hard but finds the fielder at mid off.
Nicely played! Good-length ball, outside off. Regis Chakabva stays back, opens the face of his bat and guides it past the point fielder to collect a couple of runs.
Bcak of a length, around middle. Regis Chakabva blocks it out.
Back of a length, around middle. Takudzwanashe Kaitano tucks it wide of the mid-wicket fielder and takes a single.
Dasun Shanaka brings himself into the attack. He replaces Nuwan Pradeep.
Chameera goes fuller this time, around middle. Regis Chakabva nudges it towards the square leg fielder. Much better over for Sri Lanka as just 3 runs came off it.
Another short ball, around middle. Regis Chakabva ducks underneath watchfully.
This is on a length, around middle. Regis Chakabva flicks it past the square leg fielder and comes back for the second run.
A bumper, around middle and leg. Takudzwanashe Kaitano stays back, swivels and pulls it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Good-length ball, just outside off. Takudzwanashe Kaitano blocks it off the front foot towards cover.
Length ball, around off. Takudzwanashe Kaitano prods and pushes it towards mid off.
Another bouncer, around middle. Regis Chakabva ducks under it and lets that go through.
Back of a length, outside off. Regis Chakabva ducks underneath it.
SIX! Bang! Nuwan Pradeep serves a shortish delivery, around middle. Regis Chakabva waits for it and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a biggie. First six for Zimbabwe!
On a length, around middle. Takudzwanashe Kaitano taps it towards mid on. A single taken.
Good-length delivery, around off. Takudzwanashe Kaitano hangs back and looks to block it out. But the ball goes off the bottom edge over the stumps. Dot ball.
Touch fuller, around middle and leg. Regis Chakabva pushes it towards mid on and takes a quick single.
On a length, around off. Takudzwanashe Kaitano defends it out off the back foot.
Fuller ball, on middle. Takudzwanashe Kaitano presents the full face of his bat and pushes it onto the stumps at the non-striker's end. Another dot ball.
Back of a length, on middle. Takudzwanashe Kaitano covers his line and blocks it watchfully.
An outswinger, outside off, on a length. Takudzwanashe Kaitano leaves it alone.

Dushmantha Chameera drops it short this time, on the body. Takudzwanashe Kaitano pulls it over mid-wicket. The ball doesn't reach the boundary ropes but the batters take two runs. There was an easy third there, but the batters settle for two.
Fuller ball, around off. Takudzwanashe Kaitano jabs it out towards cover-point. Dot ball.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Regis Chakabva leaves it alone. A much better over by Nuwan Pradeep this time.
Full, on middle. Regis Chakabva drives it to Jeffrey Vandersay at mid on.
On a length, on middle. Regis Chakabva defends it out.
Touch fuller, outside off. Takudzwanashe Kaitano opens the face of his bat and guides it towards deep point. There is protection in the deep. A single taken.
On a length, on the pads. Takudzwanashe Kaitano blocks it on the leg side.
FOUR! Top shot! Nuwan Pradeep overpitches this one, on middle. Takudzwanashe Kaitano shows the full face of his bat and drills it down the ground for a boundary.
FOUR! A boundary to end the over! Much fuller, outside off. Regis Chakabva leans and looks to drive, but he manages to get a thick outside edge over the slip cordon for a boundary.
Good-length delivery, around off. Regis Chakabva shows the full face of his bat and blocks it out.
An outswinger, outside off. Regis Chakabva does not fiddle with it.
Once again a good-length delivery, outside off. Regis Chakabva offers no shot.
Swing and a miss! Shaping away from outside off, on a length. Regis Chakabva looks to drive but gets beaten.
Outside off, on a length. Regis Chakabva shoulders his arms at it.
TWO WIDES! A length ball, shaping away wide of off. Takudzwanashe Kaitano leaves it alone, the keeper dives and fails to grab it. The batters rotate the strike here.
Who will bowl from the other end? Dushmantha Chameera it is.

More runs! On a length, around middle. Regis Chakabva taps it towards mid on and scampers through to the other end. The fielder there has a shy at the keeper's end and misses. The batters steal an overthrow in return. 14 runs off the first over! Good start for Zimbabwe.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Regis Chakabva leaves it alone.
On a length, around middle. Regis Chakabva pushes it past mid on for a brace.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Overpitched delivery, darting it on middle. Regis Chakabva clears his front foot and whips it towards deep mid-wicket for another boundary.

NO BALL AND FOUR! First boundary for Zimbabwe! Much fuller this time, on the pads again. Regis Chakabva flicks it towards deep square leg for boundary. He gets off the mark in style. Also, Nuwan Pradeep has overstepped and a no ball has been given. Free Hit to follow.
Another length ball, on the pads again. Takudzwanashe Kaitano tucks it towards fine leg for a single. Zimbabwe and Takudzwanashe Kaitano are up and running!
Nuwan Pradeep begins with a length ball, on the pads. Takudzwanashe Kaitano taps it towards square leg. No run there.

We are set for the game to begin! The players of Sri Lanka make their way out to the middle. Regis Chakabva and Takudzwanashe Kaitano walk out to open the batting for Zimbabwe. Nuwan Pradeep will start with the ball.

PITCH REPORT - Jon Kent says that there is a lot more grass this time, there are a few cracks as well on the pitch. Adds that the pitch has held firmly and there is no movement. Also says that the batting conditions are really good once again and it should be another high-scoring game.

Dasun Shanaka, the skipper of Sri Lanka, says that they are confident of chasing and they are ready to bat second. Tells that they must start well and fielding becomes very important at the international arena. Mentions that they have made only one change to their side.

Craig Ervine, the skipper of Zimbabwe, says that they are going to bat first, the guys did well in the first game, but they are looking to do the same once again. Adds that Sri Lankan bowlers did very well, they picked up wickets and took the momentum away from them in the first game. Mentions that they played a lot of positive cricket, they need to capitalize on that. Concludes by saying that they are going with the same team again.

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Pathum Nissanka, Kusal Mendis (WK), Kamindu Mendis, Dinesh Chandimal, Charith Asalanka, Dasun Shanaka, Chamika Karunaratne, Maheesh Theekshana, Jeffrey Vandersay, Dushmantha Chameera (In for Chamika Gunasekara), Nuwan Pradeep.

Zimbabwe (Unchanged Playing XI) - Takudzwanashe Kaitano, Regis Chakabva (WK), Craig Ervine (C), Sean Williams, Wesley Madhevere, Sikandar Raza, Ryan Burl, Wellington Masakadza, Blessing Muzarabani, Tendai Chatara, Richard Ngarava.
TOSS - Zimbabwe have won the toss and they have elected to BAT first.

Zimbabwe, on the other hand, did reasonably well in the first ODI but failed to get over the line. Their veteran, Sean Williams scored a sublime century, and he along with Regis Chakabva put up a healthy total on the board, but unfortunately, the bowlers were not able to defend the target. They too will be looking to put on a better bowling performance and will be hoping the middle-order to chip in with a few vital runs as well. The tourists will be under a little bit of pressure, but they have to make sure to play at their best in this do-or-die encounter. An exciting match coming your way! Stay tuned for toss and team news.

The hosts did exceedingly well to win the first match, although they did not put up a great performance with the ball, their batting was exceptional as they chased down the target with ease. It was a collective batting performance as three Sri Lankan batters scored over 70 runs to help them win the game. They will look to replicate the same in the second ODI, however this time they will have to put on a much better show with the ball as well. They will be coming into this game high on confidence and will be keen to seal the series.

Hello and a warm welcome to the second ODI of this exciting series between Sri Lanka and Zimbabwe. We witnessed a high-scoring game in the first ODI, with the hosts eventually clinching the game. Zimbabwe will have to put their best foot forward in this must-win encounter and keep the three-match series alive. Not to forget, the winner of this clash will also grab vital points at the ICC Cricket World Cup Super League.
